name: coordination/task-status-reply
description: `task_status` for a task this surface dispatched (ADR-0016 §2). Addressable by the dispatch receipt or by the staged reference — and by nothing else. `verification` is deliberately null-valued with a stated reason: no result can be delivered against a dispatch whose bytes never went out, and reporting an optimistic state would be the kind of lie a fail-closed capability matrix cannot detect.

verification.detail: the outbound A2A carrier for a staged coordination payload is not decided (ADR-0016 leaves the per-phase carrier table open); the consent receipt is spent and no bytes have left this machine
